text: Among the SME Instrument funded projects on serious games and game-based learning for education and training, which project pairs an immersive headset with an online training platform so that clinicians can safely rehearse on simulated patients instead of real ones?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT p.id FROM project p WHERE (p.objective ILIKE '%serious game%' OR p.objective ILIKE '%game-based learning%') AND (p.objective ILIKE '%learn%' OR p.objective ILIKE '%educat%' OR p.objective ILIKE '%training%') AND p.fundingScheme LIKE 'SME%'

reference_answer: The abcdeSIM-VR project (VirtualMedSchool, grant 781138) pairs a Virtual Reality headset with a web-based simulation platform that includes a serious game: the medical or health trainee wears the headset and performs on virtual patients in real-time under different clinical settings, without posing risk to real patients.
notes: Filter = SME Instrument (fundingScheme LIKE 'SME%') AND objective mentions serious game/game-based learning AND a learn/educat/training co-term. Survivors (3): 684657 TheCityGame pilot, 718990 LINGOKIDS, 781138 abcdeSIM-VR. Only 781138 has VR headset + web platform for medical training; other two are unrelated (language learning app, CSR sustainability app).

text: Among ERC Starting Grant projects working on ultrasound, which ones use the ultrasound waves themselves to trigger a therapeutic effect, such as releasing a drug or modulating brain activity, rather than only using ultrasound for imaging?

filter_evidence.filter_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM project p JOIN euroscivoc e ON e.projectID=p.id WHERE e.euroSciVocPath = 'natural sciences/physical sciences/acoustics/ultrasound' AND p.fundingScheme='ERC-STG'

reference_answer: Of the 10 ERC Starting Grant projects tagged under the euroSciVoc ultrasound leaf, three use the ultrasound energy itself to produce a therapeutic effect rather than only to image or track. BONDS embeds alginate microparticles designed to respond to ultrasound by releasing a plasmid-DNA payload (pPDGF) on demand, timing angiogenic gene delivery to guide diabetic-foot-ulcer wound healing. BUBBLE CURE vibrates vancomycin-decorated targeted microbubbles with ultrasound to both image and physically reduce cardiac-device-associated bacterial biofilms, reporting roughly a 20% biofilm reduction from ultrasound-triggered microbubble application. HelpUS built a focused-ultrasound neurostimulation system to non-invasively modulate deep brain activity (alongside ultrasound imaging), aiming to establish causal links between brain circuits and empathy-related decision making; the other seven survivors (ROBOTAR, ExtreFlow, MicroParticleControl, DYNA-MIC, L-SID, MUSE, GUTSY) use ultrasound only for imaging, tracking, sensing, or as a general acoustic process tool.
notes: Filter redesigned onto euroSciVoc ultrasound leaf (single-row one-reading check) x fundingScheme=ERC-STG, since objective/title ILIKE is a banned structured-filter column. 10 survivors, 3 IN on the distinction: ultrasound as active therapeutic trigger vs. imaging tool.
